(2) A quick series of cuts shows the interior of a brightly lit retail store. Shelves are stocked with neatly arranged, colorful boxes of Royce' branded sweets. (3) On a white table, a variety of Japanese sweets are presented: a round matcha-covered nut cake, a basket of chocolate bars, and plates with black and sesame-coated round snacks. The woman is seen picking up a rectangular box from a store shelf. (4) Back in the studio setting, the woman holds the 'Plum Hojicha Bar Chocolate' box and the chocolate bar itself. She gestures with her hands while speaking to the camera. Overlay graphics show the product details. (5) A hand opens a green box labeled 'Uji Matcha Nut Brulle.' The woman cuts a wedge of the dense, nutty cake and takes a bite, reacting with a wide-eyed, surprised expression of enjoyment. (6) The woman samples 'Miso Chocolate Bean Paste Balls' coated in sesame seeds. She breaks one open to show the dark filling inside. (7) Wide shots of a modern, multi-level train station interior with people walking around. The video concludes with the woman holding a large clear tax-free shopping bag filled with the featured boxes.
